question: Is predecessor-head package-install output plus focused tests sufficient for this cross-cutting reconnect refactor, or must the current head demonstrate a real reconnect path before merge?
rationale: The implementation and tests can be reviewed mechanically, but accepting non-final-head, non-live evidence for availability and delivery-recovery behavior requires maintainer judgment.

options.title: Require final-head proof
options.body: Request the external SDK install on `af7688369aecfa08bf7b625726354bc32cb95f4b` and one redacted representative reconnect transcript before merge.

options.title: Accept focused equivalence proof
options.body: Accept the predecessor package-install output and focused suites because the final delta only completes the packaging smoke and does not alter runtime code.

recommendation.title: Require final-head proof
